typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'Select  RTRIM(LTRIM(Table_Name)) AS Table_Name ,RTRIM(LTRIM(File_Date))AS File_Date ,RTRIM(LTRIM(Row_Count)) AS Row_Count ,RTRIM(LTRIM(Control_Total_Column_1)) AS Control_Total_Column_1 ,RTRIM(LTRIM(Control_Total_1)) AS Control_Total_1 ,RTRIM(LTRIM(Control_Total_Column_2)) AS Control_Total_Column_2 ,RTRIM(LTRIM(Control_Total_2)) AS Control_Total_2 ,RTRIM(LTRIM(Control_Total_Column_3)) AS Control_Total_Column_3 ,RTRIM(LTRIM(Control_Total_3)) AS Control_Total_3 ,RTRIM(LTRIM(Incurred_From)) AS Incurred_From ,RTRIM(LTRIM(Incurred_Through)) AS Incurred_Through ,RTRIM(LTRIM(Paid_From)) AS Paid_From ,RTRIM(LTRIM(Paid_Through)) AS Paid_Through FROM [EXTRACT].[FL_3M_transmission] WHERE FILE_DATE = FORMAT(GETDATE(), \'yyyyMMdd\')',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> TransmissionAudit
TransmissionAudit sink(input(
		Incurred_Through as string,
		Paid_Through as string,
		Table_Name as string,
		Control_Total_3 as string,
		Control_Total_Column_1 as string,
		Control_Total_1 as string,
		Control_Total_Column_2 as string,
		Control_Total_2 as string,
		Control_Total_Column_3 as string,
		File_Date as string,
		Incurred_From as string,
		Row_Count as string,
		Paid_From as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Incurred_Through,
		Paid_Through,
		Table_Name,
		Control_Total_3,
		Control_Total_Column_1,
		Control_Total_1,
		Control_Total_Column_2,
		Control_Total_2,
		Control_Total_Column_3,
		File_Date,
		Incurred_From,
		Row_Count,
		Paid_From)) ~> TransmissionFlatFile
